feature.label: ABAP VERTEX Tools
feature.description:
ABAP Version, Code and Data Explorer: one front end over three SAP GUI tools, inside ABAP Development Tools.
SelecTor shows a table with its selection panel, the join builder and the pivot cross. Metrics shows the code metrics of a class, program or function group. Versions shows the version history of an object, the diff between two versions, and the code review saved for a transport request.
It reads an ABAP backend that has to be installed on the system first: Simple-Data-Explorer for the resources, ACE for the metrics, AVE for the versions and the review. Without it every window opens on a page saying so, with links.
